name: io.github.progrmoiz/aired
title: aired
description: Publish HTML to a shareable link. Reports, dashboards and pages from your AI tool, one URL.

tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish HTML to a shareable URL. Returns a live URL that renders the HTML in a browser. Pass update_token from a previous publish to update the same URL. With an aired API key, pages belong to your account (permanent by default) and you can update your own pages by id without a token. Change the PIN, expiry, view limit or title later with set_options.

ttl_seconds.description: Time to live in seconds (default: 604800 = 7 days)

update_token.description: Token from a previous publish to update the same URL

id.description: Page ID — required when update_token is provided

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: A page's details: title, URL, size, views, view limit, expiry, project, and whether a PIN is on (never the PIN). For your own pages, or any page whose update_token you pass.

id.description: Page id, from publish_html or list_pages

update_token.description: The page's update token. Not needed for pages your account owns

tools.name: set_options
tools.description: Change a page's PIN (or remove it), expiry (a TTL, or permanent), view limit or title after publishing, without sending its HTML again. Send only what should change. For your own pages, or any page whose update_token you pass.

id.description: Page id, from publish_html or list_pages

update_token.description: The page's update token. Not needed for pages your account owns

title.description: New title (at most 200 characters), or null to clear it

pin.description: New PIN (4 to 64 characters), or null to remove the PIN

ttl_seconds.description: Expire this many seconds from now (60 to 31536000). Makes a permanent page expire

permanent.description: true: never expires. false: expires 7 days from now

view_limit.description: Gone after this many views (1 to 1000000), or null to remove the limit

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the aired team about a bug, friction or a missing feature in aired itself (not in the page you're building). Use it when a result surprised you, a limit blocked you or these docs were wrong. At most one per task, and don't let it hold up the task. Never include page HTML, tokens or PINs. It returns an id: tell the user you sent feedback and give them the id. It isn't a support channel.

kind.description: bug: something broke; friction: it worked but was harder than it should be; idea: something missing

message.description: What happened and what you expected, 10 to 2000 characters. Never page HTML, tokens or PINs

impact.description: How much it got in the way

page_id.description: The page it's about, if any

tool.description: The tool or command you were using, e.g. publish_html

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List your pages on aired (needs an API key): id, URL, title, views, expiry.

cursor.description: From a previous list_pages answer, for the next page of results

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Replace the HTML of one of your pages, keeping its URL (needs an API key; no update token).

id.description: Page id, from publish_html or list_pages

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete one of your pages for good (needs an API key). The link stops working.

id.description: Page id, from publish_html or list_pages

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your aired account (needs an API key): plan, limits, renewal, and an upgrade link for a person to open.
